name_story.story: Diana can be understood through the Latin form دِيَانَا, whose central sense is diana; a roman goddess's name. Diana is a European female given name, from the name of the Roman goddess Diana.

faq.a: Diana is associated with the Latin form دِيَانَا, whose core sense is diana; a roman goddess's name.

faq.q: What is the origin of Diana?
faq.a: Diana is associated with Latin. Diana is a European female given name, from the name of the Roman goddess Diana.
No — the underlying form is Latin, not Arabic.
Diana can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Latin-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Diana should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Diana is a Latin name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Diana mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Diana is rendered ڈیانا and carries the sense ڈیانا، رومی دیوی.

faq.q: What does Diana mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Diana is rendered دیانا and carries the sense دیانا، الهه رومی.
A romanized syllable approximation is dia-na. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Diana?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Diana, diana. Script forms are ديانا, دِيَانَا, دیانا, ڈیانا, डायना.

faq.q: Is Diana a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
